fit_reason: Private owner selling a complete 14 ft Lund aluminum boat with motor and trailer.
findings: Bare aluminum hull sides below the red stripe look dull and hazy with streaky staining near the bow
Interior floor and ribs show dirt, scuffs and worn grey patches in the walkways
Light green interior paint is dusty with marks along the gunwales and seat bases
Red vinyl seat cushions look faded and slightly chalky
Wooden bench seat tops are weathered and dull
Red stripe on the hull side looks somewhat faded under the cover line
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 14 foot Lund with the Yamaha. The interior floor and seats look a bit dusty and worn in the photos, and the bare aluminum on the hull sides has gone dull. We do mobile pre-sale details for boats, including cleaning the interior and polishing the aluminum and stripe, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
